import asyncio
import contextlib


async def save(x):
    pass


# CASE async_for_stream expect=pass
async def p1(stream):
    async for row in stream:
        await save(row)


# CASE nested_async_def_callback expect=pass
async def p2(items):
    jobs = []
    for item in items:

        async def job(item=item):
            await save(item)

        jobs.append(job())
    await asyncio.gather(*jobs)


# CASE async_with_per_item expect=fire
async def p3(items):
    for item in items:
        async with contextlib.AsyncExitStack():
            pass


# CASE sync_with_per_item expect=pass
async def p4(items):
    for item in items:
        with contextlib.nullcontext():
            print(item)


# CASE plain_loop_await expect=fire
async def p5(items):
    for item in items:
        await save(item)


# CASE in_order_honest expect=pass
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
